entities.name: Keldon Necropolis
entities.description: One of the holiest sites in Keld, a mountaintop fortress-city and burial site of the Witch Kings.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Land on Dominaria of the Keldons.

entities.name: Witch Kings
entities.description: Greatest Keldon warlords, prophesied to rise at the Keldon Twilight.

entities.name: Golden Argosy
entities.description: Legendary longboat and magical warship that transports the Witch Kings.

entities.name: Keldon Invasion of Jamuraa
entities.description: Invasion during which Latulla tried to awaken the warlords.

entities.name: Latulla
entities.description: Keldon who tried to awaken the warlords prematurely.

entities.name: Gorsha
entities.description: Keeper of the Necropolis who defeated Latulla.

entities.name: Warlords' Council
entities.description: Council that refused to awaken the warlords.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who fought the Keldons after the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Doyenne Tajamin
entities.description: Keldon doyenne who struck a Witch King with her cudgel.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Site of the ultimate battle for Dominaria.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event after which the area became a battleground.

events.summary: During the Keldon Invasion of Jamuraa, Latulla tries to forcibly awaken the warlords; the Council refuses.
Latulla is defeated in ritual combat by the keeper Gorsha, so the Witch Kings stay asleep.
events.quote: Latulla was defeated, so the Witch Kings were not awakened prematurely.

events.summary: After the Rathi Overlay, Keldons with Eladamri and the Skyshroud elves try to stop the Phyrexians desecrating the site.
events.quote: the Keldons tried to prevent the Phyrexians from desecrating the holy site

events.summary: The Keldon Twilight arrives and the Witch Kings rise and fight against the living Keldons.
events.quote: the Witch Kings rising up and instead fought against the living Keldons

events.summary: Doyenne Tajamin strikes a Witch King, triggering a volcanic eruption and flood.
events.quote: Doyenne Tajamin striking one of the Witch Kings with her sacred cudgel

events.summary: The Golden Argosy rescues the living Keldons and elves and carries them to Urborg for the ultimate battle.
events.quote: were rescued by Golden Argosy and were transported to Urborg

relations.quote: With the aid of Eladamri and the Skyshroud elves
one of the holiest sites in Keld
